BUSINESS STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Avoiding all community work

2. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   C. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.

3. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Marketing as rumours only.
   C. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.

4. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Measure rainfall only

5. Which statement about Savings and Investments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Savings and Investments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Savings and Investments as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Savings and Investments.
   D. Say Savings and Investments never happens in Kenya.

6. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nairobi

7. Which statement about Trial Balance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Trial Balance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Trial Balance.
   C. Say Trial Balance never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Trial Balance as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   D. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.

9. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Avoid saving forever

10. Which statement about Procurement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Procurement.
   B. Say Procurement never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Procurement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Procurement as rumours only.

11. Which statement about The Ledger is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat The Ledger as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing The Ledger.
   C. Say The Ledger never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain The Ledger with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Cash Books is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Cash Books never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Cash Books as rumours only.
   C. Explain Cash Books with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Books.

13. Which statement about Financial Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Financial Markets as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Financial Markets.
   C. Explain Financial Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Financial Markets never happens in Kenya.

14. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.
   D. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.

15. Which statement about Consumer and Investor Protection is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Consumer and Investor Protection as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Consumer and Investor Protection.
   C. Say Consumer and Investor Protection never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Consumer and Investor Protection with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

16. Which statement about Methods of Price Determination is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Methods of Price Determination never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Methods of Price Determination with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Methods of Price Determination as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Methods of Price Determination.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Savings and Investments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Financial Markets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Public Finance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Consumer and Investor Protection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Financial Regulators in Business and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Economic Planning and Development in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain International Trade and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Types of Business Ownership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
